_comment: Stable v0.9.0 scope cut approved by the maintainer on 2026-09-28.
This release ships the performance/scale foundations and supported command surfaces already integrated on main; it does not claim that every investigated optimization was implemented.
Residual four-repository profiling, staged-input optimization and persisted prepared-analysis work move to #1029 for the v0.9.x patch line.
Deferred #1026/#999/#492/#494-#501 work is neither reported as shipped nor treated as an evidence-backed rejection merely because stable v0.9.0 is published.
Required #650 keeps public documentation aligned with the exact stable capability set. Required #1030 restores the fail-closed first-party badge publisher self-pin before publication.

#1030 performs the live Stage B self-pin repair; #1034 is the mandatory post-merge Stage C rotation that binds shipped release inventory, Relay bundle, schema and CLI defaults to final merged-history identities.
#787 remains the publication authority and is intentionally not a required CLOSED prerequisite because successful packed-artifact publication is what completes it.
Known correctness, security, privacy, integrity, data-corruption or false-PASS defects remain release blockers regardless of the performance scope cut.

required_items.summary: Deliver consumer-shaped phase attribution and Health profiling used by the shipped v0.9 performance foundation
Deliver the measurement and decision framework for repeated multi-command preparation without claiming persisted prepared analysis shipped
Deliver reusable scale, complexity, memory and expected-effect benchmarking foundations
Complete the incremental PR feedback investigation while retaining full strict validation as authoritative
Measure and disposition carried-forward selector, graph, reachability and repeated-work hypotheses without speculative optimization
Complete the exact-request cache opportunity investigation without weakening fail-closed eligibility
Require fresh verified build-state capture for reviewed public API expansion approval
Normalize ArchLinterNet self-dogfood CI around build-once and evidence reuse
Resolve the focused same-session Public API optimization lane without inventing an unsupported capability
Align executable public documentation and capability claims with the exact stable v0.9.0 product
Restore the first-party Architecture Health publisher self-pin and remove the current workflow_mismatch failure
Bind shipped publisher workflow/action identities and release inventory to final merged-history commits and exact Git blobs
